script_text: Love and money collide, forcing Taurus, an Earth sign ruled by Venus, into one decisive conversation. Monday is ideal for a pitch because Jupiter nears a conjunction with Mars in your 3rd House. Tuesday’s Moon energizes your 1st House, favoring a self-directed start. Wednesday turns the pressure up: the Moon enters your 2nd and squares the 6th-house Sun, making money and authority suddenly consequential. Thursday keeps the 2nd-house tension active, but Friday’s Moon enters your 3rd and sextiles the 6th-house Sun, smoothing budgets, interviews, and work talk. Saturday favors love: Mercury in your 7th supports asking about exclusivity and shared future plans. Friday is your power day because the Moon’s 3rd-to-6th-house sextile sharpens money and career choices. Wednesday is your caution day because the Moon-Sun square squeezes both cash and workplace communication. Write down every salary and relationship request before speaking. Follow for daily updates.
